description: This file defines the EditAttachmentDialog class, a UI component for editing attachment descriptions within the notes application. It interacts with a ViewModel to fetch and update attachment data, and manages dialog UI elements like title and buttons.

classes.name: EditAttachmentDialog
classes.description: A dialog for editing the description of an attachment, which retrieves attachment data via ViewModel, and updates a text field accordingly. It returns the updated data upon save.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, retrieves attachment path and note ID from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Inflates the view binding for the dialog layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI, binds data from ViewModel, and defines the save button behavior.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Companion object method to construct and initialize an instance of the dialog with necessary arguments.
